title: Home Health Services

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: This synthetic policy identifies information used to prepare a service request for human review.

sections.heading: Coverage Criteria
sections.text:
- The request describes why skilled services are needed in the home.
- The record includes a treating-provider order and plan of care.
- The documentation explains the member's functional limitations and ability to leave home.

sections.heading: Required Documentation
sections.text:
- Ordering provider and order date
- Requested skilled services and frequency
- Homebound assessment
- Functional and safety limitations
- Goals, expected duration and discharge plan

sections.heading: Limitations and Exceptions
sections.text:
- Need for general assistance alone may not establish a skilled-service requirement.
- Custodial and skilled services must be distinguished.
- Human clinical and benefit review is required.

sections.heading: Decision Boundary
sections.text: Meeting the listed criteria does not automatically approve the request. Eligibility, benefits, exclusions, clinical context and applicable requirements must be reviewed by an authorized human reviewer.

disclaimer: Synthetic policy created for software demonstration and evaluation. It is not medical or insurance guidance.
